fi-astronotus-ocellatus.title: Oscar
fi-astronotus-ocellatus.summary: The oscar, Astronotus ocellatus, is a large cichlid widely distributed in the Amazon region, recorded from Colombia and Venezuela south to Argentina. It grows to 350 mm SL and typically lives 10 to…
rows: Omnivore. This species is a generalised omnivore , feeding on a range of items including smaller fish, insects, crustaceans, zooplankton and various types of both terrestrial and aquatic vegetation in the…
Widely-distributed in the Amazon region and has been recorded in Colombia, Venezuela, Bolivia, Ecuador, Peru, Brazil, French Guiana, Paraguay, Uruguay and Argentina.
notes: Unsuitable for the carefully-aquascaped aquarium since it has a tendency to dig into the substrate but otherwise relatively unfussy.
A natural-style set-up could include a soft, sandy substrate, relatively dim lighting plus some large driftwood roots and branches.
